directed_by: Joe direct chat 2026-08-23: the point of conditional-build reverse scaffolding is finding things that would fit and do not conflict, with a clear and plausible pathway; full derivation without the source action is not the bar
target_claim_note: installs a claim grade; kills no source claim and no research route

defect_fixed.gap: every rung above speculative requires a derivation; 'conditional' means derived-given-grant-G, which is strictly stronger than what reverse scaffolding produces
defect_fixed.observable_consequence: successfully built rung objects terminate as BLOCKED_WITH_NAMED_GAP or 'waits on the source action' because the only alternative was to overclaim them as derived
defect_fixed.verified: no fit/no-conflict/pathway grade existed in lab/methods, lab/process, RESEARCH-POSTURE.md or CONTRIBUTING.md before this change

grade.definition: a structure explicitly built at a named descent rung, conflicting with no recorded repository result and no registered source claim, carrying an explicit named pathway to derivation together with the conditions that would falsify that pathway

admission_criteria.name: built, not gestured
admission_criteria.requirement: the object is constructed and its structure fingerprint is stated in full: carrier, pairing or form, real structure, grading, signature horn, ambient embedding; PD-STRUCTURE-TRANSPORT binds and a changed fingerprint requires an adapter or returns OBJECT_CHANGED

admission_criteria.name: rung named
admission_criteria.requirement: the descent rung R6..R1 the construction lives at, what it is conditional on from below and what it supplies above

admission_criteria.name: non-conflicting, checked
admission_criteria.requirement: checked against the recorded corpus with the search NAMED: the relevant no-gos, kills, path-dependency chains and prior closes; 'no conflict found' without a stated search is not a check

admission_criteria.name: source-compatible, checked
admission_criteria.requirement: checked against lab/sources/source-claim-register.yaml with polarity respected: violating an ASSERTS claim is a conflict and so is relying on a DISAVOWS reading; the SC- ids checked must be named

admission_criteria.name: pathway named
admission_criteria.requirement: an explicit route to derivation naming what must be supplied, WHICH OWNER supplies it, and the next executable step; a pathway that reduces to 'the source action must exist' is not a pathway but the blockage this grade exists to stop restating

admission_criteria.name: ceiling and demotion stated
admission_criteria.requirement: states that the construction is not a derivation and may not be cited as one, and states the demotion condition: if the pathway is shown blocked or a conflict surfaces it drops to speculative or negative rather than silently persisting

admission_criteria.name: nontriviality witness
admission_criteria.requirement: the construction names at least one thing it forbids: an excluded value, an excluded structure, or an observable whose measurement would falsify it. A construction that forbids nothing constrains nothing and is not admitted. FC-1 through FC-6 test consistency; only FC-7 tests content, and a sufficiently weak object passes the other six trivially by saying nothing.

explicitly_not_licensed: compatibility as derivation, which RESEARCH-POSTURE.md lists among the forbidden moves and this grade does not relax
moving a conditional-physics ledger row toward SAME
any verdict change by itself; ledger effects go through ordinary evidence-delta process
target fitting; choices freeze before evaluation, inheriting the CBRS owner-before-evaluation discipline
anti_laundering_features: FC-1 requires an actual object with a full fingerprint, which is expensive and checkable
FC-3 and FC-4 require named searches, so an unchecked claim is visibly unchecked
FC-5 forbids the degenerate pathway that restates the blockage
FC-6 makes the grade revocable rather than permanent
the grade is barred from ledger movement and prediction credit, so it cannot inflate the scoreboard
FC-7 requires a nontriviality witness, so an object that is consistent only because it is contentless is refused
relationship_to_descent: a FITTING CONSTRUCTION is what a descent rung produces when it succeeds; an accumulated set across rungs whose pathways compose is precisely a clear and plausible pathway for the whole theory, held at honest grade without anyone claiming derivation
amendment_2026_08_23: FC-7 added the day the grade was installed, on the process council's seat-5 recommendation, before anything had been banked at the grade. The council recorded this as the single most important change on its list: it decides whether the grade is a research instrument or a laundering channel.
